_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 15: 2025-05-16 to 2025-06-06. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was taken in the spirit and saw the calendar pass to the summer of 2026, that great shifting and change is coming in 2026, and going into 2027 he saw a major new plague trying to come.
mentions.quote: Going into 2027, I told you I saw a major plague
mentions.falsify_match: A new pandemic emerging in 2026 or 2027.

mentions.claim_text: He says those without a foundation of the word of God in their heart will not make it, as most did not have one going into 2019 and 2020 and COVID.
mentions.quote: won't make it. You must have a foundation of the word of God
mentions.condition_text: survival conditioned on having the word as a foundation
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a condition that explains any individual outcome after the fact.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that you cannot have a part-time relationship with God and a full-time devil, because the devil is not after you part-time.
mentions.quote: you're not going to be able to have a part-time relationship with a God
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls asking the Lord in 2023 whether what he was seeing was a nuclear weapon because it went up like a mushroom cloud, alongside an invitation to enter into his rest.
mentions.quote: is this a nuclear weapon? because it went up like a mushroom cloud
mentions.falsify_match: A nuclear or comparably large explosion.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, and the answer he received is cut off here.

mentions.claim_text: He describes seeing Israel and a baby wrapped in a blanket, says he does not understand it, reads it as a rebirthing and new things, and notes something about patriotism running from June through the following month.
mentions.quote: the baby wrapped in the blanket with Israel. I don't understand all that
mentions.falsify_match: A founding or rebirth event involving Israel in that window.

mentions.claim_text: He says great war is breaking out between Israel and Iran in the days ahead, and that back in January he saw an American missile striking a mountain that was an underground city, with Iran setting all kinds of deterrence to stop it.
mentions.quote: I saw a American missile striking a mountain that was an underground city
mentions.falsify_match: An American strike on a hardened underground Iranian facility, which the June 2025 Fordow strike would match against a January statement.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such strike, or no locatable January statement.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw refineries, gasoline and petroleum plants, and describes what follows when they strike the refineries.
mentions.quote: Refineries. I saw refineries. And when they strike the refineries
mentions.falsify_match: Strikes on Iranian refining and petroleum infrastructure.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him in 2023 that gas would skyrocket and oil would go up to two hundred dollars a barrel, with big money flowing that would stimulate the American economy.
mentions.quote: I saw it going up $200 a barrel, like big money trying to flow
mentions.falsify_match: Oil reaching $200 a barrel.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Oil fell rather than rose after the June 2025 strikes.

mentions.claim_text: He says he reported in January that Trump wanted to go about it diplomatically and would not push the button, but Israel did it anyway, and that he has been seeing a black swan event.
mentions.quote: I'm not pushing the button, but Israel did it anyway
mentions.falsify_match: Israel striking Iran ahead of and against American preference, plus a black swan financial event.
mentions.falsify_miss: The strike half matched June 2025; the black swan half is undated.

mentions.claim_text: He discusses someone buying Bitcoin shares, wonders whether that drove the all-time high, and notes it is now crashing back down and cycling up and down.
mentions.quote: Maybe that's what made it go to an all-time high, but now it's crashing
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim; market commentary.

mentions.claim_text: He describes getting an inward image each year of a level of blessing and of ministry, and that it happens every year with his daughter Megan.
mentions.quote: an inner image of this. And that's what it happens every year with Megan
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a recurring private impression.

mentions.claim_text: He says he received an inward image that it happens by 45, his birthday on 3 July, and that he and his wife are believing for it, framing it as changing negative thinking.
mentions.quote: an inward image of that by 45. This is my 45th birthday on July 3rd
mentions.falsify_match: His daughter's healing arriving by 3 July 2025, which the family would report.

mentions.claim_text: In spontaneous prayer he sees Israel, blue and white and the star of David, moving from July.
mentions.quote: seeing Israel. I see blue. I see the white. I see the star of David
mentions.falsify_match: Something involving Israel in July 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing, though no content is attached to the image.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a calendar with June and a military parade, patriotism carrying into July, hears rebirthing in America and sees a baby.
mentions.quote: I see June. and this this military parade. And I see patriotism going into July
mentions.falsify_match: The 14 June 2025 military parade and a surge of patriotic feeling into July.
mentions.falsify_miss: No parade or no such mood.

mentions.claim_text: He hears brotherhood from sea to shining sea with Ray Charles singing, and says he simply reports what he hears.
mentions.quote: with brotherhood from sea to shining sea
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an impression with no content.

mentions.claim_text: He says technological advancements have been caged in a box and are being released now in 2025, visible with Google and the other major companies, and asks whether it can be avoided.
mentions.quote: caged and it's going to be released now. We're seeing it being released 2025
mentions.falsify_match: A step change in publicly released AI capability during 2025.

mentions.claim_text: An aside about his air conditioning compressor failing, moving into Trump saying Putin is crazy.
mentions.quote: your compressor went out on your air conditioner
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: domestic aside.

mentions.claim_text: He says that if it takes place, and he prays it does not, it was in the Warsaw area, and that when it happens he saw World War III headlines with everybody joining in and coalitions with China, Iran and North Korea.
mentions.quote: it was in Warsaw area
mentions.condition_text: he prays it does not happen in the same sentence
mentions.falsify_match: A trigger event near Warsaw drawing in a China, Iran and North Korea bloc.

mentions.claim_text: He compares himself to an umpire calling the play as he saw it, while people in the stands at a different angle yell that he heard and saw it wrong.
mentions.quote: all the ump is doing is is is saying exactly what he saw
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a defence of his own vantage point against correction.

mentions.claim_text: Asked how he knows, he says a calendar flashed before his eyes and he went through the fall, the winter and the spring and parked at a point.
mentions.quote: a calendar flash before my eyes and I went all the way through the fall
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as given: the parking point is not named in this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says that by the summer of 2026 America and everything else will look so much different from now, and that he sees the economy and sees the black.
mentions.quote: the summer of 2026, things look so much different than they do even right now
mentions.falsify_match: A transformed America by summer 2026 with a dark economy.

mentions.claim_text: He says everything is happening at lightning speed and asks how it affects the end times and the timing of Christ's coming.
mentions.quote: all this is happening at at lightning speed
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a power source that never loses its power, saying a glass of water holds more energy than a nuclear reactor.
mentions.quote: of water has more energy in it than than than a a a nuclear reactor
mentions.falsify_match: A water-based energy technology entering use.

mentions.claim_text: He urges tipping servers generously to the point where it hurts the flesh, as a way of showing God's love that may change how they see you.
mentions.quote: I just try to show God's love until the point of where it's painful
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether they are in the last days or not, says it is time to believe for the impossible, and says he is done with being a Christian who only barely sees signs follow.
mentions.quote: Are we going to see signs will follow them that that believe?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation with a belief condition.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that a bottle of water has more energy in it than a nuclear reactor, saying he is trying hard to describe what he saw the day before.
mentions.quote: a bottle of water has more energy in
mentions.falsify_match: Same claim as eEd1C8oRkiE@944, restated within a week.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has seen things since he was a teenager and that he later developed the prophetic ear for really hearing the voice of the Lord, asking not to be crucified for saying so.
mentions.quote: I started developing the the prophetic ear of really hearing the voice
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an account of his own development.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord used to tell him about the weather, including how much rain there would be, and that the weather was his favourite of these, though it works differently now.
mentions.quote: he would tell me about how much it was always something
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: recollected private forecasts.

mentions.claim_text: He says he used to pick the winning teams for March Madness, but the Lord told him that if he ever bet or gambled on it he would never speak to him that way again because it was private between them.
mentions.quote: ever bet or gamble off of this of what I've telling you, I'll never speak
mentions.condition_text: the gift is withdrawn if it is ever used in a way that could be verified by a wager
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable by design, and stated as such: the one class of prediction that could be scored is placed under a prohibition.

mentions.claim_text: He says he would hear in April how the weather would run all through the summer, that he wrote things down, and that they always knew when weather was coming because God talked about it.
mentions.quote: hear in April how the weather was going to be all through the summer
mentions.falsify_match: The written records he mentions would settle it, if they exist and are dated.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2025 will be the best year and a golden window of opportunity, the year of supernatural wealth transfer, and that they are entering the foundation of the beginning of the end and the great financial digital platform.
mentions.quote: 2025 the golden this golden window of opportunity for 2025 to be the year
mentions.falsify_match: A visible transfer of wealth in 2025 and a digital financial platform emerging.
